comment: Verification contract for T-008 (high, tdd per the risk-gate-matrix high-tier row). stack: shell waives lint/typecheck/build. unit-tests / acceptance-tests carry TDD red_evidence (the round-2 RED captures, 133/5 both runtimes against the pre-fix validator, i.e. the panel-round-1 remediation's own red) and green_evidence (138/0 both runtimes); the sh capture is the unit check, the pwsh capture the acceptance check, together proving both runtimes. requirement-traceability runs check-traceability against the feature's traceability.json (8 links, exit 0). regression covers the eight sibling suites (block 327/0, match 125/0, cli 13/0, discovery 24/0, lite 18/0, parity 70/0, metamorphic 150/0, resolver-evidence-schema 20/0) at the post-panel-round-2 state. This is a Security-Sensitive task: a fresh cross-model panel ran BEFORE this gate and reached consensus PASS on bundle digest adfde612 (2 distinct vendors, anthropic + openai, all PASS, no Critical; aggregate at verification/T-008.cross-model.json), under the human-issued sudo consent token. The original RED (round 1) and the round-2 RED both exist under verification/T-008/; the contract cites the round-2 pair because it is the red that matches the shipped (post-remediation) validator. spec_revision is the current requirements+design+acceptance-tests concatenation hash. Gate cycle 1 correction (evaluator seq 0819): the first placeholder-scan capture over-scoped the scan to include the suite driver, whose five hits are its own template-token constants; the scan's usage note takes changed production files, so the evidence log was re-captured over T-008's three production validator files (exit 0). The regression tally cited here is the post-panel-round-2 block figure (327/0).
